title: Check the type of a file
summary: Use the `file` command to identify what kind of file a specific file is (e.g., text, image, executable, compressed archive). This is useful when a file has no extension or the wrong extension.

steps.explain: Run the `file` command followed by the path to the file you want to inspect. It will output a description of the file's content type.

placeholders.name: FILE
placeholders.description: The path to the file you want to check.

steps.expect: Output describing the file type, e.g., 'PDF document, version 1.4'.
